name: hadolint
description: Installs the hadolint Dockerfile linter from GitHub releases.

hadolintVersion.description: hadolint version to install (without the leading v)

sha256Amd64.description: SHA-256 of the hadolint amd64 binary for the selected version (required on amd64)

sha256Arm64.description: SHA-256 of the hadolint arm64 binary for the selected version (required on arm64)
